title: Proactive error-floor trimmer and regional evacuation limiter
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: During a recent multi-region surge (INC-3456) we observed repeated regional evacuations triggered by brief transient error spikes. Evacuations were expensive and caused oscillation; in some cases a downstream KV pressure cascade made recovery slower. This PR introduces two coordinated safety mechanisms: 1) an error-floor trimmer that computes a robust baseline (error floor) per-region and suppresses evacuation triggers for transient spikes that do not meaningfully exceed the baseline; and 2) a regional evacuation limiter that rate-limits forced evacuations and introduces a soft cool-down window so repeated evacuations are avoided. Both are conservative by default and can be gradually enabled via runtime flags and config. Key goals: reduce repeated evacs from noise, prevent oscillatory behavior between regions, keep SLOs stable by preferring short soft-shed behavior over costly hard evacs when appropriate.

release_notes: Introduce conservative error-floor trimming to reduce evacuation churn and add a regional evacuation limiter that rate-limits forced evacuations. Default config is conservative; see docs/ops/evacuation-tuning.md for rollout and tuning guidance.
notes_and_risks: This change reduces hard evacuations for transient noise but increases time-to-hard-fail for genuine sustained region degradation by the configured cooldown. Operators should monitor error_floor.delta and evacuation_limiter.cooldown metrics during rollout. Runtime flags allow immediate rollback. No schema or API changes.
